title: ExaModels.jl: an Algebraic Modeling System for Nonlinear Programming on GPUs
summary: Large-scale nonlinear programs almost always exhibit partially separable and repetitive structure, yet most existing algebraic modeling systems do not take advantage of it. A nonlinear optimization solver queries the objective, the constraints, and their derivatives at every iteration, so the speed of these evaluations bears directly on the overall solution time. We present ExaModels.jl, a Julia-based algebraic modeling system that exploits this structure to evaluate the objective, the constraints, and their derivatives in parallel.
